title: •Lobot
caption: •Lobot (V)
game_text: Deploys free to Cloud City or a site with a scomp link. If a battle was just initiated at same site, may ▼ an alien here (free if Lando) as a ‘react’. May ▼ one Cyborg Construct on Lobot.
lore: Former criminal. Fitted with a cybernetic device. Now repays his debt to society by ensuring the smooth running of Cloud City. Becomes disoriented when not with a computer.
copyright: TM & © 1997 LUCASFILM LTD. TM, ® & © 1997 DECIPHER INC.
notes: Unique. Stats POWER 2 / ABILITY 2, third box blank; deploy 2 / forfeit 5. Icon column empty (only the set sphere). Alien (Cloud City frame, alien disc). Slip prints two ▼ triangles where the stub expands 'Deploy on table from Reserve Deck; reshuffle'; curly single quotes around ‘react’. Lore matches the scan. Base scan only at 350 px; copyright 1997 (Cloud City) not legible here. Modern: V0-L-lobot.gif (745 px, PC remake); VB2 -pre (350) also exists, not downloaded.
